title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Rights Statement: Billing Error Disputes
content:
**Right to dispute.** A Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards cardmember may dispute one posted transaction as a billing error for one of these reasons: unauthorized charge, duplicate charge, amount incorrect, credit not posted, merchandise not received, or payment not credited. Notices by online form, mail or phone are all handled on the same schedule.

**Notice window.** The notice is received within the card's dispute notice window after the statement date of the first statement on which the disputed transaction appeared. The window counts calendar days starting the day after that statement date as day 1, and a notice received on the last day of the window is timely. A notice received later is not opened as a billing dispute. The statement date and the billing period of the transaction are read from the account's statement and transaction records.

**One open dispute per transaction.** The disputed transaction has no other dispute that is still open. A dispute is open from its filing until a resolution or a withdrawal is recorded for the same disputed transaction; a resolved dispute is not reopened for the same transaction and reason.

**Timetable.** The dispute is acknowledged within the card's acknowledgement days and resolved within the card's number of complete billing cycles, and never later than the card's maximum days after the notice date.

**While a dispute is open.** The disputed amount is excluded from the minimum payment, accrues no interest, draws no late fee and is not reported as delinquent, and the account may not be restricted for not paying it.

**Credits and rebills.** For unauthorized-charge and duplicate-charge disputes a temporary (provisional) credit of the disputed amount posts within the card's temporary credit business days. Resolution in the cardmember's favor makes a provisional credit final with no further entry, and for the other reasons posts a final credit of the disputed amount. A charge found correct as billed, or a dispute withdrawn by the cardmember, reverses any provisional credit with a rebill; the rebilled amount is not payment-due before the card's grace period in calendar days after the resolution date. Unauthorized use never costs the cardmember more than the card's unauthorized use liability.

**Store purchases.** A credit-not-posted dispute for a Marlowe & Finch return is resolved in the cardmember's favor only when the purchase's return record shows the merchandise was received back, and a merchandise-not-received dispute only when the delivery record shows no completed delivery.

## Window boundary (hypothetical statement dated 5 March, 60-day window)

| Notice received | Day of the window | Timely |
|---|---|---|
| 6 March | day 1 | yes |
| 4 May | day 60 | yes |
| 5 May | day 61 | no |

## Outcomes by reason

| Reason | Provisional credit | In the cardmember's favor | Correct as billed or withdrawn |
|---|---|---|---|
| unauthorized charge, duplicate charge | yes | provisional credit becomes final | provisional credit rebilled |
| amount incorrect, credit not posted, merchandise not received, payment not credited | no | final credit of the disputed amount | nothing to rebill |
